say:1:1430247201:1.text: Yes, that commoner! He just became the Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard!
say:1:1430247201:1.source_cn: 没错，他不过是平民出身，现在却成了萨洛克兰的卫队长！
say:1:1430247201:1.male: Yes, that commoner! He just became the Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard!
say:1:1430247201:1.female: Yes, that commoner! He just became the Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard!

say:2:1430247202:1.text: There are so many qualified candidates among the nobility who are better than him. Why was he given such an important position?
say:2:1430247202:1.source_cn: 我们贵族中有这么多比他优秀的人选，为什么偏偏是他被重用？
say:2:1430247202:1.male: There are so many qualified candidates among the nobility who are better than him. Why was he given such an important position?
say:2:1430247202:1.female: There are so many qualified candidates among the nobility who are better than him. Why was he given such an important position?
